source_notes: Amigo LNG (LNG Alliance + Epcilon LNG, Guaymas, Sonora) now intends to take FID in early Q1 2026, per CEO statements reported by LNG Prime (pub. 2025-12-16). GEM's FIDYear of 2025 (a Pre-FID target) is now superseded by the Q1 2026 target. Forward-looking target from a single trade-press source — yellow. Train 1 first cargoes still targeted ~Oct 2028 (GEM LatestPlannedStartYear 2028 unchanged).
scope_note: FIDStatus remains Pre-FID; only the targeted FID year moves. Applies to the T1 unit-row (T2 has no FIDYear populated).
